column1: # Served rows whose scope comes from arguments the client chose, with no server guard (lane L3 S4, Q1-B).
# Per-user access (A1) must not lift while this file has rows; test/rust-served-a1-lock.test.ts enforces it.

column2: no privacy clause at all: the entity title and anchored pages come back for any id the client names; add the caller's page policy or drop unreadable ids
any source and slug the client names returns its entity id for a live page, private or not; keep only pages the caller may read
privacy depends on the excludePrivate argument the client sends; force excludePrivate on remote frames
visibility applies only when the client sends remote:true; take the remote mark from the frame, not the arguments
chunk text of a private page leaves the server when the client sends excludePrivate false; force excludePrivate on remote frames
answers withdrawal counts, the latest withdrawal time and a digest of the source's access rules, for any source the client names
readers is a client argument and coverage rows are not filtered to readable sources; pin readers to the caller's bound identity
page ids and source ids are client arguments; limit them to pages and sources the caller may read
existence oracle: answers for any slug the client names, private pages included; drop slugs the caller cannot read
size oracle for private pages by id, set by the client's excludePrivate argument; force excludePrivate on remote frames
returns host fields (trace_path, owner_pid, owner_host_id) for any source the client names; limit source ids to readable sources
slugs are client arguments and identity siblings can be private pages; limit slugs to pages the caller may read
the visibility policy is a client argument and the answer tells a hidden page from a missing one; pin the policy to the remote policy
existence and date oracle: answers for any source and slug the client names, private pages included; the slug must be readable by the caller
the page id is a client argument and the writer's principal id comes back for any page; the op checks visibility first, the raw member does not
synopsis of private body text, set by the policy the client sends; force excludePrivate on remote frames and limit refs to readable pages
